product.title: YOU-DRIVE UTV Hell's Revenge 4x4 Off Roading Tour from Moab

description.text: Experience Utah's thrilling Hell's Revenge Trail on a UTV with this excursion. Traverse steep climbs and slick rock as you head to your destination—the Colorado River Overlook. Stops include Hell's Revenge, Colorado River. Transportation, safety gear, and local commentary are handled so you can focus on the red rock landscape. Ideal for travelers basing in Moab who want a guided Utah adventure without self-driving backcountry roads or river put-ins.
